body:
We should keep previous version at https://konard.github.io/voice-simulator/v1, yet in the new version we should try to faster detect that hardware cannot handle simulation.

We should also think of the ways to optimize simulation (giving the same waveform in faster time).

I'm surprised it was working at all, yet it worked, please find a way to make our 3D model more realistic and more precise to biological shape of the mouth of humans, if you can find some references online to make it more anatomically correct.

At the moment the 3D visual view is too simplified, if that is what affects actual sound that means we need more details, yet we can still have levels of details of 3D shape itself.

We also need to make position of microphone configurable, and also a box around the virtual head, so we can have different settings for reverb.

So not only sound quality levels, but also 3D levels of details.

It would be nice to have presets for ranges of randomization for both male and female voices, now it sounds closer to male voice only.

We should also add wav to settings back, so we can find the closest match of settings that are more similar to voice from recording.

So we can actually copy the voice.

We need to make sure we make our system fully configurable with all details matter to how the the generated speech sounds. Also we need to handle all possible linguistic aspects as accents, punctuation and so on.

Make sure we double check everything and make sure that everything is state of the art as possible.

We should also check all the competitor projects and take best practices from them by reimplementing them our way, but with same key ideas.

We also need to use everything we can learn from scientific community like from https://youtu.be/HmSYnOvEueo and other sources.

So we must strive to perfection and exceed the quality of other competitors.

We also need to make sure we have teeth and tongue simulation both visually and acoustically.

It is also important to support different audio formats, so it will be easier to use them.

And we should highlight each word that is read at the moment + each syllable single highlighed word, so it will be easy for user to understand what is simulated audio is talking at the moment.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Increase precision where possible
